analysis.hypothesis: The reference model computes mean over dimension 1 followed by GELU. Since the only custom ops are mean_dim and gelu, and both are non-convolutional, they will be implemented as CUDA kernels. A single custom_ops.cu can contain both kernels and launchers. The mean_dim kernel reduces along the specified dimension, and gelu is elementwise. Memory accesses are coalesced by mapping contiguous output elements to threads and striding over the reduction dimension.
evidence: model_new.py calls cuda_extension.mean_dim(x, dim_tensor) and cuda_extension.gelu(x).
custom_ops_contract.json specifies mean_dim reduces float32 input [16,1024,512,256] along tensor scalar dim (value 1) to [16,512,256]; gelu elementwise on float32 tensor.
No convolutional operations exist, so cuDNN is not needed.
